UNDEFINEDFILE-ONCODE.note: ONCODE of UNDEFINEDFILE for a missing DD: Zeus 80. Record the z/OS value (PL/I Messages and Codes lists 80-89 by cause).

PD109A.note: Implementation-defined representations; expected values are the current Zeus behavior.

HFP-SHORT-TENTH.note: Decimal 0.1 to short HFP: Zeus truncates (X40199999); Enterprise COBOL in Zeus rounds (X4019999A). Record which the PL/I compiler does.

HFP-LONG-TENTH.note: Decimal 0.1 to long HFP: Zeus X401999999999999A.

HFP-BIN21-TENTH.note: FLOAT BIN(21) maps to short HFP; same truncation question as HFP-SHORT-TENTH.

TENTH-TO-FIXED-DEC.note: Short HFP 0.1 (truncated, below 0.1) to FIXED DEC(5,2) truncates to 0.09 in Zeus. If z/OS gives 0.10 the HFP constant is rounded or the conversion rounds.

FLOAT-TO-CHAR.note: FLOAT DEC(6) to CHAR: Zeus gives a leading blank and a four-digit exponent ( 1.00000E-0001).

STG-ENTRY-VARIABLE.note: STORAGE of an ENTRY variable: Zeus 8 (entry point and environment).

STG-LABEL-VARIABLE.note: STORAGE of a LABEL variable: Zeus 8.

STG-FILE-VARIABLE.note: STORAGE of a FILE variable: Zeus 4.

STG-HANDLE-OFFSET.note: STORAGE of HANDLE and OFFSET: Zeus 4 each.

STG-AREA.note: STORAGE of AREA(100) and the default AREA(1000): Zeus adds a 16-byte header (116, 1016).

NULL-VALUE.note: NULL(): Zeus XFF000000 (the NULL370 form). Record the DEFAULT(NULLSYS/NULL370) setting used on z/OS.

AREA-EMPTY-HEADER.note: The 16-byte header of an empty AREA is not published; Zeus has all zeros.

OVERLAP-SUBSTR-RIGHT.note: Overlapping SUBSTR assignment to the right: Zeus copies byte by byte from the left (propagation).

OVERLAP-SUBSTR-LEFT.note: Overlapping SUBSTR assignment to the left: Zeus value.

DEC-OVER-NO-SIZE.note: FIXED DEC(3) assigned 1000 with SIZE disabled: the result is undefined in the Language Reference; Zeus keeps the low-order digits (X000C).

STATIC-NO-INIT.note: STATIC without INITIAL: Zeus gives binary zeros for both FIXED BIN and CHAR.

RANDOM-SEED-ONE.note: RANDOM(1): the generator is not published; Zeus value.

KEY-DUPLICATE-ONCODE.note: The ONCODE values for KEY (51 key not found, 52 duplicate key) follow the current Zeus implementation; confirm on Enterprise PL/I.

KEY-MISSING-ONCODE.note: The ONCODE values for KEY (51 key not found, 52 duplicate key) follow the current Zeus implementation; confirm on Enterprise PL/I.
